biography.value:
Brown dragons swim beneath desert dunes and burst up to snatch prey from caravans. They rarely fly, and they are patient hunters who can wait a week beneath the sand for the right meal.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .6kNtuZbdDysm0UKJ]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .0FPBu8uRhluJXlBW]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .GoILkzdqGbP4blHX]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=mf8nYX82AsFmTG7P]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=mf8nYX82AsFmTG7P]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=mf8nYX82AsFmTG7P]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=12WEYOGbly72YKKT]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Sand Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a blast of scouring sand in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=p7MMwOBxXzxfJHLb]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=p7MMwOBxXzxfJHLb]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=p7MMwOBxXzxfJHLb]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Blinding Sand. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its blinding Sand in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=PCwJpjpZ3q84ASwL]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=PCwJpjpZ3q84ASwL]] saving throw or be &Reference[blinded] until the end of its next turn.
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can burrow through sand as fast as it walks, and it can hold its breath for 1 hour.
In the first round of combat, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • A sinkhole opens in a 20-foot square: DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be &Reference[restrained] until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Sand whirls in a 20-foot sphere; the area is heavily obscured.
  • The dragon burrows up to its burrow speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
